ruleDefinitions.name: Potential Persistence Via PowerShell User Profile Using Add-Content
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects calls to "Add-Content" cmdlet in order to modify the content of the user profile and potentially adding suspicious commands for persistence Note: Unmapped fields: ScriptBlockText

sequences.query: (ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Add\\-Content\\ \\$profile.*") AND (ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\-Value\\ \\"IEX\\ .*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\-Value\\ \\"Invoke\\-Expression.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\-Value\\ \\"Invoke\\-WebRequest.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\-Value\\ \\"Start\\-Process.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\-Value\\ \\'IEX\\ .*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\-Value\\ \\'Invoke\\-Expression.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\-Value\\ \\'Invoke\\-WebRequest.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\-Value\\ \\'Start\\-Process.*")))
